John, Kate, Jack, Emma—at 100 tons, we could sustainably catch 10 tons each and let the remaining 50 double back to 100. But I’m proposing we each choose 15 tons this month: $15,000 apiece rather than $10,000. I intend to choose 15, and I’m asking you to match me.

That’s not sustainable: if we all do it, only 25 tons remain, recovering to 50 next month. We’d be taking income now at the expense of future catches. Still, choices are private and simultaneous, so holding yourself to 10 doesn’t guarantee anyone else will. Who’s willing to take the larger immediate payout rather than leave more of this month’s catch available to the rest of us?
